description: Runtime context variables exposed via PostgreSQL current_setting('app.<name>', true).

variables.name: app.user_id
variables.purpose: Application account id (auth.users, access grants, security events)

variables.name: app.job_role
variables.purpose: Acting employee job role (values in job_role_vocab.json)

variables.name: app.region_id
variables.purpose: Sales region of the acting employee

variables.name: app.user_clearance_level
variables.purpose: Security clearance level of the acting user

variables.name: app.position_level
variables.purpose: Position level of the acting employee

variables.name: app.hire_date
variables.purpose: Hire date of the acting employee (multi-policy bundles only)

missing_session_semantics: If a required variable is NULL (current_setting('x', true) IS NULL), the policy must deny.
